nodes.title: Records
nodes.text: How a user keeps records and how an operator takes a record out of use.

children.title: The title of a record
children.text: The service creates a record only if its title has from 1 to 80 characters.
children.reason: A user finds a record in the list by its title, and a title longer than one line of the list cannot be read there.

children.title: Archiving a record
children.text: An operator archives a record by its number. The list of records holds only the records that are in use, so archiving takes a record out of the list.
children.reason: A record that nobody needs any more crowds the list, yet it may be needed again, so it is kept rather than deleted.

children.title: The order of the list
children.text: The list of records shows the most recently created record first.
children.reason: A user most often looks for the record they have just written.

decisions.problem: Whether the list of records is sorted by title or by the time at which each record was created.
decisions.ruling: By the time of creation, the newest record first, since users most often look for the record they have just written.
